leucocyte cathepsin is much less efficient than leucocyte elastin in solubilising elastin, that the elastin fragments obtained with both enzymes have similar isoelectric points and amino acid compositions but that the fragments obtained with cathepsin are much more heterogeneous than those obtained with elastase.

leucocyte and neutrophil elastases are more efficient in degrading elastin than cathepsin.
